caption:
IT services hiring hit an 18-month high in September — roughly 57,000 active openings, with about 60% of that demand sitting at the mid-senior level. That's your level. Which means the résumé is no longer the filter. Everyone in the final room has the credentials.

The filter is the 45 minutes itself. How you enter. Where your voice sits when someone interrupts. Whether you fill silence or use it. Panels don't remember bullet points; they remember bearing.

Thirty-five years of military command taught Colonel Suhag one thing that transfers cleanly to a boardroom: authority is carried, not claimed. Posture before words. Tone before content. A pause held on purpose does more work than another paragraph.

The September number will be replaced by October's. The window is open now. Walk in holding the room, not hoping for it.

topic.title: IT hiring hits 18-month high, mostly mid-senior roles
topic.angle: Lumina's buyers are exactly the mid-senior professionals this rebound targets, and with 60% of demand at their level the deciding filter is no longer the résumé but how they hold a 45-minute room.
topic.why_now: The ~57,000 active openings figure is the September 2026 number, reported across trade press in the last 72 hours to three weeks, and it will be superseded by October data.

rationale: A stark, text-only visual matches the no-nonsense tone and puts the hiring figures front and centre without diluting them with stock imagery.
